corrected_claims: 1. A system for ai agents, comprising: six-tool mapped elements wherein a line-path module (110), a triangle hierarchy unit (120), a square bound frame (130), a cross decision branch (140), a circle node anchor (150), and a curvature flow shaper (160) jointly define an ai agents array; and an autoread block (170) emitting a machine-readable build record ending STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the line-path module (110) governs the data flow path through the ai agents array pipeline.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the triangle hierarchy unit (120) governs decision hierarchy fanning from the ai agents array core.

4. The system of claim 1, wherein the square bound frame (130) bounds memory and system bounds containing the ai agents array and triggers a re-solve from a single controlled origin when a bound is crossed.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the cross decision branch (140) decides branch logic where ai agents array paths intersect as solvable forks re-derivable when conditions change.

6. The system of claim 1, wherein the circle node anchor (150) anchors nodes and endpoints orbiting the ai agents array as radial datums holding position while surrounding geometry flexes within tolerance.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the curvature flow shaper (160) shapes load and latency curves governing ai agents array behavior to eliminate sharp discontinuities.
8. The system of claim 1, further configured to operate at WORKERS of 4.
9. The system of claim 8, further configured to operate at UPTIME of 99.99% within BATCH of 16.

10. A method of producing an ai agents array, comprising in order: seeding a grid to anchor the ai agents array as a binary-1 identity at a single controlled origin; setting the finished function as the destination on an infinite line and back-solving toward the origin; routing the target through line, triangle, square, cross, circle, and curvature tools; admitting human variance in perspective, chance, and tolerance slop; and emitting the ai agents array as one valid build among infinite option paths.
11. The method of claim 10, wherein seeding comprises establishing the single controlled origin from which every downstream dimension of the ai agents array is derived.

12. The method of claim 10, wherein routing comprises claiming, per tool, the geometry belonging to the line-path module (110), triangle hierarchy unit (120), square bound frame (130), cross decision branch (140), circle node anchor (150), and curvature flow shaper (160), resolving conflicts by re-solving from the origin.
13. The method of claim 10, wherein admitting human variance comprises holding the WORKERS of 4 while tolerating builder, operator, and environment variation.
14. The method of claim 10, further comprising emitting the machine-readable build record ending STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID and verifying the record before release.
15. The system of claim 1, produced by means comprising containerization, wherein the means follow the six-tool sequence of the ai agents array.
16. The system of claim 15, wherein the means further comprise calibration and QA burn-in with the autoread block (170) stamped on the unit.
17. The system of claim 1, further comprising a network interface coupling the ai agents array to a remote node, wherein the autoread block (170) is transmittable to the remote node for verification.
18. The system of claim 1, wherein the autoread block (170) records as-built WORKERS of 4 and UPTIME of 99.99% per unit such that behavioral drift between units is machine-detectable.
19. The method of claim 10, wherein a failed verification of the build record returns the ai agents array to the back-solving step rather than releasing a drifted unit.
20. The system of claim 1, wherein the six tools are re-weighted for a past, current, or future operating era without changing the single controlled origin.

glossary.standard_term: hierarchical decision tree (directed acyclic structure fanning from the core)
bounded execution sandbox: memory and system boundary enforcement that triggers re-solve from the origin when a bound is crossed
conditional branch router: fork/join control-flow unit at path intersections
anchored node registry: fixed reference datums holding node and endpoint positions
load/latency smoothing controller: shapes throughput curves to remove discontinuities
build attestation record: machine-readable verification manifest ending STATUS=SIGNATURE-1 VALID
